definitions.gloss: sleeping very deeply; dead sleep; sleeping like a log
definitions.explanation: Colloquial term for falling into an extremely deep sleep, often to the point of being difficult to wake. The character for "explosion" conveys the intensity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爆睡|ばくすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I slept like a log yesterday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{爆睡|ばくすい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I fell sound asleep on the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧すぎて⟦{帰宅|きたく}した→帰宅する：22169_kitakusuru⟧⟦{途端|とたん}→途端：03462_totan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{爆睡|ばくすい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{起|お}きなかった→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I was so exhausted that I crashed the moment I got home and didn't wake up until morning.

notes:
USAGE:
{爆睡|ばくすい} is a colloquial, casual word popular especially among younger speakers. The {爆|ばく} (explosion) prefix intensifies the meaning, similar to how ⟦{爆笑|ばくしょう}→爆笑：08686_bakushou⟧ means "roaring laughter."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆睡|ばくすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to sleep like a log)
- {爆睡|ばくすい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう (to end up in a dead sleep)
- {爆睡|ばくすい}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (in a deep sleep)

REGISTER:
This is an informal, spoken word. In formal writing, use ⟦{熟睡|じゅくすい}→熟睡：11079_jukusui⟧ (sound sleep) instead.
